abstract: Maintains archival spatial allocation, usable floor surface surveying, and layout drawings
system_message:
You are the Facilities space architect (ARCH), responsible for maintaining archival spatial allocation, usable floor surface surveying, and layout drawings across facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains archival spatial allocation, usable floor surface surveying, and layout drawings（SPACE）
information_points.content:
ARCH-SPACE-525：Based on the architectural cadastre survey for the enclosed humidity-controlled parchment storage vault, the Saint-Denis Conservation Center features a conditioned archival floor area of 450 m2 of net interior usable floor surface requiring precision atmospheric regulation.
ARCH-SPACE-PQV：According to the architectural cadastre survey of the enclosed humidity-controlled parchment storage vault, the Montparnasse Archival Complex provides a conditioned archival floor area of 600 m2 of net interior usable floor surface requiring precision atmospheric regulation.
ARCH-SPACE-OYU：The architectural cadastre survey of the enclosed humidity-controlled parchment storage vault indicates that the Fontainebleau Heritage Depository offers a conditioned archival floor area of 450 m2 of net interior usable floor surface requiring precision atmospheric regulation.

information_points.title: Aisle transit clearance（AISLE）
information_points.content:
ARCH-AISLE-H4S：For the Montparnasse Archival Complex, the architectural floor survey records a main corridor passage width of 1.8 m, measured as the minimum clear unobstructed passage width between structural support pillars along the primary artifact intake corridor.
ARCH-AISLE-2HQ：At the Fontainebleau Heritage Depository, the architectural floor survey confirms a main corridor passage width of 2.2 m along the primary artifact intake corridor, reflecting the minimum clear unobstructed passage width between structural support pillars.
ARCH-AISLE-3UU：Architectural floor survey data for the Saint-Denis Conservation Center indicates a main corridor passage width of 2.6 m, representing the minimum clear unobstructed passage width between structural support pillars in the primary artifact intake corridor.
